title: Digital Marketing for Career Impact — Certificate Program
tagline: Learn SEO, SEM, social media, analytics and AI content by running real campaigns — and walk out with a portfolio, not just a certificate.
audience: Non-technical undergraduate students (B.Com, BBA, BA, B.Sc) in affiliated colleges. No coding required.
language: English, with bilingual (Kannada / Hindi) campaign examples
weeklyCommitment: ≈ 5 hours: 2 h guided session · 1.5 h self-study · 1.5 h lab / project
prerequisites: Comfortable using a smartphone or laptop and a web browser
A Google account (for Search Console, GA4, Keyword Planner, Looker Studio and Sheets free tiers)
Basic English reading; Kannada / Hindi speakers are supported throughout
No marketing, statistics or design background needed
outcomes: Explain how the digital marketing ecosystem fits together — search, social, content, email and paid media — and choose the right channel mix for a given goal.
Run a full SEO workflow: keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical and local fixes, and link building, using free tools.
Plan and produce a content calendar that mixes human judgement with AI-assisted drafting, fact-checking and brand-voice control.
Set up and reason about paid campaigns on search and social: auctions, budgets, targeting, ad copy and landing pages.
Measure everything that matters: build KPI trees, read GA4, assemble dashboards, and optimise campaigns with experiments.
Run email and automation journeys that respect consent, including India's DPDP framework.
Ship an integrated campaign end-to-end and present it with evidence — the portfolio employers ask for.

conditions: At least 3 of 4 Project Blocks submitted
Attendance / activity ≥ 75% of guided sessions (instructor-led batches)
Score at least 60% on each module mini-assessment; all eight must be passed for the platform completion certificate.

components.name: Lesson quizzes
components.description: Every lesson ends with a short quiz. Best attempt counts; the average across all lessons is scaled to 15 marks.

components.name: Project Blocks 1–4
components.description: Four applied projects (7 marks each): SEO audit, content engine, campaign plan and analytics dashboard, graded on the rubric in assessments/rubrics.md.

components.name: Capstone: integrated campaign + pitch
components.description: A two-to-four-week integrated campaign for a real or realistic client, with live assets, data and a 5-minute Demo Day pitch.

components.name: Final assessment
components.description: A 90-minute assessment (60 MCQs + two scenario responses) drawn from the blueprint in assessments/final-assessment-blueprint.md.

components.name: Reflection journal
components.description: Weekly reflection entries completed inside lessons; graded on completion and honesty, not length.

toolkit.note: Search Console needs a website you control — the course labs use a free blog or a college club site.
No paid spend is required. Labs use draft campaigns, planning templates and simulation numbers.
Free tiers are enough. AI drafts every artefact, but every artefact is also checked, edited and owned by you.

modules.title: Digital Marketing Foundations
modules.summary: What digital marketing actually is, how customers move from stranger to fan, how to research an audience and its competitors, and how to write the one-page brief every campaign needs.
outcomes: Map the channel ecosystem — search, social, content, email, paid — and match channels to business goals
Describe the customer journey and build a simple funnel with realistic conversion maths
Run audience and competitor research with free tools and turn findings into personas
Write a one-page marketing brief with a SMART goal and a KPI tree

Build a keyword map with intent, volume and difficulty, and assign keywords to pages
Optimise a page's titles, headings, content and internal links for humans first
Diagnose technical and local-SEO issues and earn links without spam
Deliver a prioritised, evidence-based SEO audit (Project Block 1)

Run an AI-assisted content workflow — brief, draft, fact-check, edit, disclose — without publishing hallucinations
